mission: Frank v0.1 voll lauffähig auf Andreas PC
hypothesis: A delimiter-bound lexical membrane can quotient horizontal-trivia variation while preserving Needle relation/call meaning and preventing V18-style reserved-prefix shadowing.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Delimiter consumption can make trivia semantically active at statement boundaries, rejecting V17-valid bare dotted qids even if relation/call and longer-prefix qid fixtures look clean.

representative_failures: Needle.ownsXSFOgYkXXFVnT -> stolen by owns relation prefix
Needle.owns_CKeqCZCx39YL -> stolen by owns relation prefix
Needle.lowersershipLyn -> stolen by lowers relation prefix

fresh_counterevidence_fusion.reconciliation: The 10000-case nuisance-group experiment remains valid only for its bounded relation/call/prefix-qid orbit. It omitted the bare-qid plus trailing-trivia/comment statement-boundary orbit that falsifies exact V19. Therefore it is auxiliary positive evidence for boundary discrimination, not evidence for V19 promotion.

ordinary_postlex_feasibility_check.observation: With WS_INLINE ignored, a simple Lark postlex layer does not receive the horizontal trivia needed to discriminate the current boundary; exposing that trivia requires changing lexer/grammar handling and adds coupling before any proven V17 production defect.
ordinary_postlex_feasibility_check.decision: Do not introduce a postlex/prelexer semantic path merely to remove V17 lookahead. Preserve less-change-more-compile unless an executable V17 failure forces it.

architecture_delta.typed_ir: DO_NOT_OVERWRITE_CONCURRENT_PR145; replay only after exact selected grammar/frontend provenance is fixed
architecture_delta.new_test_obligation: Any future relation-boundary replacement must include statement-boundary nuisance orbits: bare Needle.owns/lowers with spaces/tabs before newline/comment/end, relation/call trivia metamorphics, longer-prefix qids, strict construction, full G9+Dialect, canonical semantic-hash differential, and downstream typed-IR replay.

current_causal_model.rule: Close and provenance-bind the parser boundary first, then replay the isolated typed-IR candidate under identical selected frontend bytes; do not infer WP04 readiness from either partial fix.

lark: strict LALR rejects unresolved shift/reduce conflicts
contextual lexing can resolve lexical overlap only within parser-allowed terminals
advanced lookaround can limit interegular collision detection
postlex is available for basic/contextual lexers but does not by itself make ignored trivia observable
external_primary_evidence.bison: Conflict identity/counterexamples matter more than merely driving conflict count to zero.

next_frontier: Keep V17 selected unless executable counterevidence proves a production defect.
Finish exact V19-or-successor falsification/Ubuntu evidence without race-editing concurrent parser work.
After parser provenance is stable, replay current-main typed IR versus isolated keyword-identifier candidate under identical G9+Dialect inputs.
Require registered Andreas Ubuntu target evidence before formal WP02/BASE promotion.
